T0537.title: Dependency Confusion
T0537.definition: A supply-chain attack in which a malicious public package with a matching name is chosen instead of the intended internal dependency.
T0537.description: Dependency confusion abuses a name collision between an internal package and a public package so the build system chooses the attacker's public package. Defenses require private-source priority, package namespaces, lock files, allowlists, and build-network policy. Reviews should check resolver behavior and mirror configuration across language ecosystems.
T0537.usageExample: Assess Dependency Confusion related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
